Repo precedent: all three cited unit tests mock a flat db.commit AsyncMock, NONE mocks a context manager; repo-wide grep for db.begin()/session.begin() in tests returns ZERO hits and production has exactly one (main.py:92, AsyncEngine not AsyncSession). So the binding shape has no mocking precedent here at all. Suggested fix: assert on db.begin.call_count, db.begin.return_value.__aexit__ (count + exc-info), and db.execute.call_args_list ordering — never db.commit() for this boundary.
